company.name: Inkeep
company.description:
Inkeep is a platform to ship AI Agents for customer experience, go-to-market, and operations teams.

Inkeep Agents are deployed at scale today with leading companies like Anthropic, Midjourney, Clay, and PostHog.

With Inkeep, teams get an intuitive drag-and-drop visual agent builder while engineers get a developer SDK with all the code-based tools they expect. Agents can be edited in either format with full 2-way sync, so engineering and non-technical teams can collaborate.

productsAndServices.description: A platform for building, orchestrating, and deploying conversational and workflow AI agents for customer experience, support, product, operations, sales, and marketing teams.

productsAndServices.description: A professional service for designing, integrating, validating, deploying, and improving production AI agents for enterprise scenarios.
productsAndServices.name: Enterprise Agent Engineering Services

productsAndServices.name: Inkeep Open Source Agent Framework

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $13,000,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $7,065,759 to $54,767,346, a 7.75x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
